title: config: add no_new_privileges option
body:
## Summary

Add the `no_new_privileges` boolean to the `[containers]` configuration table. It defaults to `false` and prevents container processes from gaining additional privileges when enabled.

## Changes

- Add `NoNewPrivileges` to the common `ContainersConfig`.
- Document the option in `containers.conf.5.md`.
- Add config tests for parsing `true` and for the default when the key is absent.

Related: podman-container-tools/podman#30046
